manifest.cap_rule: nearest-rank p90 of the statistic over 48-month windows starting >= 1960-01 (or the row's first month) and ending <= 2020-12; index ceil(q*n)-1 of the ascending sort; integer by construction
manifest.price_convention: seller entry quote p = clamp(V0 + 0.5*sigma0, 0.05, 0.95) from forecast/table.json; the matched pool's implicit 0.5 is not used for the demo

products.name: Fuel Pass-through
products.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the weekly rows dated inside the calendar month, floored to 1e-4 usd
products.note: research product; not settled on chain this weekend

forecast.model: AR(1) on the integer row, closed-form OLS on 1960-01..2020-12; simulated paths rounded to integers; exact recursions
forecast.label: Forecast (AR(1) baseline, advisory). Settlement uses the realised path only.

labels.fuel: research product, not executable this weekend
labels.cash: keep the budget as a cash reserve

prices.note: the matched pool's implicit 0.5 is not used

planner.objective: TailLoss95 = mean of the largest ceil(0.05*N) shortfalls U_k = max(L_k - (B - c) - H_k, 0); ties -> lower stake, then cash, excess, fuel
planner.scenario_note: 318 overlapping 48-month windows 1990-08..2017-01 (ending <= 2020-12); an empirical decision score, not independent episodes or a calibrated probability
